The '''Lenico system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] near [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], coreward of [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]].

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the worlds of the Lenico system were known to have enormous and mysterious monuments carved from native stone.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Monuments to Dust}}</ref>

It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lenico IV]], as well as many [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], including the [[Cairn Installation]]. [[Kyle Katarn]] traveled to the Lenico system in search of [[Desann]] and his [[Reborn]] and discovered the secret Cairn Installation where the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] was building the giant troopship ''[[Doomgiver]]'' for the attack on the [[Jedi academy]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].
